description: Six-panel figure of grain-size distribution histograms, all sharing identical axes: x = "Grain diameter (μm)" with printed ticks at 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44 (data span roughly 3-45 μm), y = "Fraction (%)" from 0 to 16 with gridlines every 4 %. (a)-(e) are transverse cross-sections of SLM-printed Fe-30Mn-9Al-C-3Ni at, per the caption, P-70, P-90, P-110, P-130 and P-150; (f) is the longitudinal section of P-110. Bar fill colour differs per panel (dark blue (a), medium blue (b), dark blue (c), cyan (d), pale green (e), yellow-green (f)) but no colour legend is given. Each panel carries a printed in-panel label: "Average grain size:8.1 μm" (a), 10.6 μm (b), 11.0 μm (c), 13.9 μm (d), 14.3 μm (e) and 14.9 μm (f). Every distribution is right-skewed: the modal bar lies in the lowest few-μm bins, the tallest bar falls from just below the 16 % gridline in (a) to only slightly above 8 % in (e), while the fraction of large grains grows; a secondary cluster of bars near 16-22 μm appears in (b)-(f) but not (a). Together the panels demonstrate that increasing laser power coarsens the cross-sectional grain structure, and that the longitudinal section of P-110 is coarser than its cross-section.

subfigures.description: Dark-blue bar histogram of grain diameter (μm) vs fraction (%), cross-section of P-70. Strongly right-skewed, tallest bar at the lowest few μm bins reaching just below the 16 % gridline, long thin tail to ~44 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:8.1 μm".

Medium-blue histogram, cross-section of P-90. Modal bar slightly lower than in (a), tail populated out to ~44 μm and a weak secondary cluster of bars around 16-22 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:10.6 μm".
Dark-blue histogram, cross-section of P-110. Similar shape to (b) with a secondary cluster near 16-20 μm and bars persisting near 40-44 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:11.0 μm".
Cyan histogram, cross-section of P-130. Modal bar near the 12 % level, broader tail with bars up to ~38 μm and a secondary peak around 16-18 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:13.9 μm".

Pale-green histogram, cross-section of P-150. Lowest modal bar of the cross-sectional series (just above the 8 % gridline), flatter and more extended distribution with a secondary cluster near 16-24 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:14.3 μm".

Yellow-green histogram, longitudinal section of P-110. Right-skewed with modal bars near 4-8 μm reaching about the 12-13 % level and a spread tail to ~44 μm. Printed label: "Average grain size:14.9 μm".

observations.observation: All six panels share the same axes: x = "Grain diameter (μm)" with printed ticks 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, and y = "Fraction (%)" running 0-16 with gridlines every 4 %.
Each panel contains an in-panel printed value of average grain size: (a) 8.1 μm, (b) 10.6 μm, (c) 11.0 μm, (d) 13.9 μm, (e) 14.3 μm, (f) 14.9 μm.
Every distribution in (a)-(f) is right-skewed with the modal bar in the lowest few-μm bins and a long, ragged tail extending to about 40-44 μm.
The height of the modal bar decreases across the cross-sectional series: in (a) it reaches just below the 16 % gridline, whereas in (e) it is only slightly above the 8 % gridline.
A secondary cluster of bars at roughly 16-22 μm is visible in (b)-(f) but is not present in (a).
Panels use different bar fill colours (dark blue for (a) and (c), medium blue for (b), cyan for (d), pale green for (e), yellow-green for (f)) with no legend mapping colour to condition.
No numeric values are printed on individual bars and no error bars, mean/median markers or curve overlays appear on any panel; fractions can only be read against the 4 % gridlines.

The caption states that (a)-(e) are transverse cross-sections of SLM-printed Fe-30Mn-9Al-C-3Ni samples P-70, P-90, P-110, P-130 and P-150, and that (f) is the longitudinal grain-size distribution of P-110.
The citing text states average grain sizes of 8.1, 10.6, 11.0, 13.9 and 14.3 μm for P-70, P-90, P-110, P 130 and P-150 respectively (Fig. 8(a-e)).
The citing text states the longitudinal section of P-110 has an average grain size of 14.9 μm, larger than its 11.0 μm cross-sectional value (Fig. 8(f)).

The citing text attributes the coarser longitudinal grains to faster horizontal cooling (melt pool coupled to metal substrate) than vertical cooling (against gas), which yields smaller grains in the cross-section.
The citing text states that both the proportion of large grains and the average grain size increase continuously as laser power rises from 70 to 150 W.

The citing text links the strength/plasticity optimum to a trade-off: low-power samples (P-70, P-90) have smaller average grain size but large porosity, while high-power samples (P-130, P-150) have small porosity but large grain size.
